title: Defra community plugin manifest
description: Schema for plugins/<plugin-name>/plugin.json — the manifest for a single community-contributed plugin.

name.description: Plugin identifier in kebab-case. Must match the directory name.

description.description: Brief description of what the plugin does.

license.description: SPDX licence identifier. 'OGL-UK-3.0' is the repo default; a plugin may use a different SPDX licence instead, provided it ships its own plugins/<name>/LICENSE file with the full text.

dependencies.description: Names of other plugins in this same marketplace whose skills or hooks this plugin's agents reference. A plugin cannot depend on one published only in the official defra-ai-plugins marketplace. Declaring dependencies lets the validator catch references to skills the user may not have installed, and lets READMEs document the install order.
